name: StarKist Chunk Light Tuna in Water (Drained Can or Pouch)
whyItWorks: Wild skipjack tuna packed in water provides 20g+ of pure lean animal protein per can with virtually zero fat (under 1g) and zero fiber. Extremely light on digestion and easy to flake into soft bites.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain water completely. Mix with 1 tablespoon of plain mayonnaise or olive oil and spread on white toast or saltines.
watchOuts: Avoid canned tuna packed in heavy spicy oils or containing celery/onion seasonings.
